$comment: GENERATED. Resolved token values for Figma sync, documentation and tooling.

ink-6.description: Disabled only. Below AA as text by design.

ink-7.description: Hints, placeholders, timestamps, footers: anything a person needs to read that is not body copy

cream-0.description: Content well. One barely visible step below the chrome, the same 1.03 luminance ratio as ink 0 to 1. Lighter than the #EDE9E4 the reference skin shipped, which is too dark for accent text.

cream-6.description: Disabled only. Below AA as text by design.

cream-7.description: Hints, placeholders, timestamps, footers: anything a person needs to read that is not body copy

dusk-2.description: Cards, tables. One small step above the chrome, so the sidebar and cards read at one depth.

dusk-6.description: Disabled only. Below AA as text by design.

dusk-10.description: Headings, emphasis. Short of white on purpose.

red-1.description: Tinted. Accent text on dark surfaces.

red-2.description: Hover for accent-coloured text and icons on dark

red-3.description: Product accent. Icons, borders, active indicators, and the solid fill under a white label (4.50:1). The centre of the banner gradient.

red-4.description: Shaded. Accent text on light surfaces: 4.50:1 on the page well, 4.62:1 on the chrome, 5.24:1 on white.

red-5.description: Fill hover, and link hover on light.

green-1.description: Pastel. Large status surface and chip background on light (12% of the fill into white, OKLab).

green-2.description: Chip edge on light: 32% of the fill into white, fitted to 1.3:1 on the chip (step 1).

green-3.description: Large-surface border on light (45% of the fill into white).

green-4.description: Success text and graphics on dark.

green-5.description: Fill, under a white label (4.63:1). The 3px edge on dark status surfaces.

green-6.description: Success text on light, as light as 4.5:1 on its chip and the page allows.

green-7.description: Chip edge on dark: 46% of the fill into the dark card, fitted to 1.3:1 on the chip (step 8).

green-8.description: Chip background on dark (26% of the fill into the dark card).

green-graphic.description: Success graphics on light: dots, glyphs, progress fills. As light as 3:1 on the page and on its own chip allows.

green-chart.description: Success as a chart segment on light, beside a legend or label that carries the number. Holds 2:1 on the card; lighter than the graphic step so a light chart reads as one family.

amber-1.description: Pastel. Large status surface and chip background on light (22% of the fill into white).

amber-2.description: Chip edge on light: 63% of the fill into white, fitted to 1.3:1 on the chip (step 1). Amber's fill is pale, so its edge takes more of it than green or scarlet.

amber-3.description: Large-surface border on light: 92% of the fill into white, fitted to match green and scarlet (1.6:1 on the surface, step 1). Amber is so light that it takes most of the fill to get there.

amber-4.description: Fill, under a dark label. The 3px edge on dark status surfaces.

amber-5.description: Warning text and graphics on dark.

amber-6.description: Warning text on light, as light as 4.5:1 on its chip and the page allows.

amber-graphic.description: Warning graphics on light. As light as 3:1 on the page and on its own chip allows.

amber-chart.description: Warning as a chart segment on light, beside a legend or label that carries the number. Holds 2:1 on the card; lighter than the graphic step so a light chart reads as one family.

scarlet-1.description: Pastel. Large status surface and chip background on light (10% of the fill into white).

scarlet-4.description: Danger text and graphics on dark.

scarlet-5.description: Fill, under a white label (4.61:1). The 3px edge on dark status surfaces.

scarlet-6.description: Danger text on light, as light as 4.5:1 on its chip and the page allows.

scarlet-7.description: Chip edge on dark: 40% of the fill into the dark card, fitted to 1.3:1 on the chip (step 8).

scarlet-graphic.description: Danger graphics on light. As light as 3:1 on the page and on its own chip allows.

scarlet-code.description: Parse errors in code on light: danger deep enough for 4.5:1 on the diff line tints, which the lighter danger text no longer reaches.

scarlet-chart.description: Danger as a chart segment on light, beside a legend or label that carries the number. Holds 2:1 on the card; lighter than the graphic step so a light chart reads as one family.

stone-1.description: Info text and graphics on dark.

stone-3.description: Info text on light, as light as 4.5:1 on its chip and the page allows.

stone-graphic.description: Info graphics on light. As light as 3:1 on the page and on its own chip allows.

stone-chart.description: Info as a chart segment on light, beside a legend or label that carries the number. Holds 2:1 on the card; lighter than the graphic step so a light chart reads as one family.

categorical-dark-4.description: Magenta. L 0.75, a step above the others at this level so it holds 4.5:1 as syntax-string on the diff line tints.

categorical-dark-8.description: Slate, near-neutral. L 0.84. The remainder series: other, unallocated.

categorical-light-1.description: Blue. L 0.62, under a dark label. Lifted above its natural weight so a 6px marker dot does not read as black.

categorical-light-2.description: Orange. L 0.70, under a dark label.

categorical-light-3.description: Teal. L 0.64, under a dark label. The same teal as dark.

categorical-light-4.description: Magenta. L 0.55, under a white label.

categorical-light-5.description: Violet. L 0.74, under a dark label. Kept a step above blue so protanopes can separate them.

categorical-light-6.description: Gold. L 0.76, under a dark label. 2.2:1 on the card, the lightest of the set.

categorical-light-7.description: Green. L 0.62, under a dark label.

categorical-light-8.description: Slate, near-neutral. L 0.66, under a dark label. The remainder series.

categorical-light-text-1.description: Blue at text strength, for syntax on light.

categorical-light-text-2.description: Orange at text strength, for syntax on light.

categorical-light-text-4.description: Magenta at text strength, for syntax on light.

categorical-light-text-5.description: Violet at text strength, for syntax on light.

paper.description: Brand cream insert. Used for the paper panel treatment, never as a UI surface.

space-micro.description: Inside a control: icon to label, chip and badge padding

space-tight.description: Button padding, between tightly related controls

space-snug.description: Between related elements in a group

space-compact.description: Dense content padding: table cells, list rows, toolbars

space-base.description: Default gutter: card padding, grid gaps

border-hairline.description: The only border width. Separation comes from hairlines, not weight.

border-edge.description: A colour bar, not a border: the status edge on dark callouts and tiles, and the active nav marker.

font-mono.description: The machine voice: code, identifiers, versions, tracked labels

text-2xs.description: Tracked uppercase labels only, mono or sans. Never other text.

text-xs.description: The floor for all other text: dense metadata, stat labels, chart axis labels

text-lg.description: Between card titles and page titles; no fixed role yet

text-xl.description: Page titles, list and detail pages alike. Stat figures

text-2xl.description: Display. Not used in the consoles today

surface-page.description: Body, the content well behind cards

surface-inert.description: Chart grid, track fills, skeleton states

surface-subtle.description: Tint wash over an unknown surface: nav items, chips, zebra rows

surface-scrim.description: The backdrop behind a modal or drawer: the page colour at 80%, so what is underneath stays legible as context and the raised surface reads as the only lit plane.

content-disabled.description: Disabled controls. Exempt from AA per WCAG 1.4.3, and never the only signal that a control is off.

border-default.description: Card and input edges, the default

border-control.description: The edge of a control whose edge is the whole affordance: an unchecked checkbox or radio, a switch track, the outline of a chart track. 3:1 on every surface (WCAG 1.4.11). Not for cards, inputs or dividers.

border-accent.description: Active tab underline, focused input, selected row rail

border-focus.description: The focus ring colour, for an outline where a component already carries a ring or shadow. Otherwise the ring is shadow-focus.

accent-default.description: Accent icons, borders, active nav indicators

accent-hover.description: Hover for accent icons and links

accent-text.description: Accent-coloured text and links, and the active nav marker bar. Tinted because the product accent reaches only 3.85:1 on surface-card.

accent-fill.description: Primary button background. White on it is 4.50:1.

accent-fill-hover.description: Primary button hover: the fill at 90%, so it lightens slightly over its backdrop. White on it is 4.0:1 over light surfaces, a documented exception, and 5.2:1 over dark ones.

accent-subtle.description: Active nav item pill, selected row: accent text at 20%

accent-gradient.description: The logo gradient. Marks and rules only, nothing on top of it.

accent-gradient-fill.description: Banner gradient: the logo's end colours with the accent fill held across the middle, where the text sits. White text only on the solid band.

status-success-chart.description: The state as a chart segment, beside a legend or label that carries the number. On light it is lighter than `default` so a chart reads as one family with the series; on dark it is `default`.

status-warning-on-fill.description: Dark label. The warning fill is too light for white.

status-danger-default.description: A true red, separate from the crimson accent.

status-info-default.description: Neutral grey. The brand has no blue.

status-info-subtle.description: Neutral chips are the hover grey, with no edge.

status-info-surface.description: Info is neutral in both themes and takes no edge.

syntax-plain.description: Scalars and anything the grammar leaves unscoped.

syntax-key.description: Mapping keys, properties, tags and attribute names: the structure a reader scans first.

syntax-constant.description: Numbers, booleans, null, and language constants.

syntax-keyword.description: Keywords, operators with a name, and YAML anchors and tags.

syntax-comment.description: Comments, set in italic. Secondary rather than muted, because comments also sit on the tinted lines of a diff and have to stay at 4.5:1 there.

highlight-match.description: The fill behind a search match, in code and in a table or list: a deep blue that keeps every syntax token at 4.5:1. The outline, not the fill, is what makes a match findable.

highlight-match-border.description: The 1px outline of a search match, at 3:1 on the surfaces text sits on.

highlight-added.description: The tint on an added line in a diff. Its lightness is capped by the quietest syntax token, so it differs from the card by hue rather than by brightness.

highlight-added-emphasis.description: The changed words within an added line: the same lightness as the line tint at three times the chroma, so it reads as more green rather than as lighter.

highlight-removed.description: The tint on a removed line in a diff.

highlight-removed-emphasis.description: The changed words within a removed line.

shadow-focus.description: Focus ring. Never removed without a replacement.

surface-page.description: Body, the content well behind cards

surface-inert.description: Chart grid, track fills, skeleton states

surface-subtle.description: Tint wash over an unknown surface: nav items, chips, zebra rows

surface-scrim.description: The backdrop behind a modal or drawer: near-black at 55%, dark enough that the raised surface reads as the only lit plane while the page stays legible as context.

content-disabled.description: Disabled controls. Exempt from AA per WCAG 1.4.3, and never the only signal that a control is off.

accent-text.description: Accent-coloured text and links, and the active nav marker bar. Shaded because the vivid fill cannot be used as text on cream: step 4 passes AA on the page well, the chrome and white.

accent-subtle.description: Active nav item pill, selected row: accent text at 8%

page-title.description: The one heading that names the page, list and detail pages alike. One per page.

section-title.description: Names a card, panel, modal or section within the page.

stat.description: A headline number on a stat card or summary tile. Tabular figures.

body.description: The content itself: table cells, form values, paragraphs, list items, page descriptions, empty states.

body-strong.description: The body text that identifies a row or a record: the name in the first column, the value a key/value pair exists to show.

control.description: Text a person clicks: buttons, tabs, nav items, menu items, segmented controls.

label.description: Names a value that sits next to it: form field labels, the key in a key/value pair, filter names.

meta.description: Supporting text about something else: timestamps, counts, the email under a name, helper text under a field, pagination summaries.

badge.description: Text inside a chip, pill or status badge.

overline.description: Uppercase, tracked. Groups or captions other content: sidebar group names, stat card captions, table column headers.

overline-mono.description: Uppercase, tracked, mono. The machine voice as a label: environment badges, resource kinds above a name.

annotation.description: Text drawn inside a chart or diagram: axis labels, legends, data labels. Nothing outside a chart uses it.

mono.description: An identifier standing on its own: IDs, versions, hashes, IPs, paths, node names. Inside a sentence, code keeps the sentence's size and only switches face.

code-block.description: Multi-line code, config and log output.
